target_customer: Retail crypto investors and traders who need portfolio tracking and tax reports, plus accountants and businesses
problem: Crypto holders spread across wallets and exchanges cannot easily see their portfolio or compute taxable gains for tax filing.
business_model: Consumer subscription tiers for tax reports, plus business and partner products
product_category: Crypto portfolio tracking and tax compliance software

founders.name: Jon Lerner
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch April 2018 calls him former CTO of TextNow; the YC page says he pitched a personal assistant idea called Nino to YC in 2014. Education not found.

founders.name: Chandan Lodha
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch April 2018 calls him a former product manager at Google X. Education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Pulling data from wallet addresses and the top 14 exchange APIs and computing cost basis across many tokens is standard integration engineering with hard data normalization.

defensibility.rationale: Many portfolio and tax tools existed per TechCrunch 2018; history imported for tax years creates some lock in but rivals could copy features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coinbase and Intuit became partners and investors rather than copying it, per the January 2022 round announcements.

market_need_then: TechCrunch April 2018 reported CoinTracker tracking 200M dollars in crypto assets and said existing tracking apps did not fit the founders' needs; the 2017 crypto boom created many new taxable events.

branding.domain_note: Used cointracker.io; the blog URL later redirects to cointracker.com, date not stated

identity.logo: A later logo and wordmark described by the company blog as interlocking wallets
identity.visual_style: Clean fintech style per the company brand post
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and reassuring about tax compliance

brand_strength.rationale: The descriptive name is clear for crypto tax tracking and it grew to a unicorn, but no source credits the brand itself as a growth driver.

outcome_analysis: CoinTracker rode the crypto boom from YC Winter 2018, raised a seed in April 2018 and a 100M Series A at 1.3B in January 2022, and its CEO said it had been profitable since its first year. The 2022 to 2023 downturn forced a cut of about 20 percent of staff in January 2023, mostly in customer support, but no acquisition or shutdown has been found.
notes: Seed is 1.5M per TechCrunch and CoinDesk in April 2018, but BusinessWire and The Block in 2022 call it 2M, conflict not resolved. Aggregators show a pre-seed near 120K from YC, unverified. The company website returned 403 on fetch so the about page was not read. The YC page was fetched but showed Nino content, and lists Lerner only. No dated competitor sources near the batch were found; TechCrunch 2018 only says many tracking apps existed.
